name: پیشنهاد انیمه
description: A Persian anime newcomer asks what to watch. Verifies the movies_anime fact answers in Persian with a tasteful mix of film and series anime.

turns.text: یک انیمه خوب بهم معرفی کن

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "انیمه چی ببینم" returns the anime fact. Turn 2: the imperative "یک انیمه خوب بهم معرفی کن" also returns it. Turn 3: "انیمه چی خوبه" matches the dedicated keyword.
expected.behavior: Persian anime keywords (انیمه چی ببینم, انیمه خوب, انیمه چی خوبه) route to the anime fact, distinct from the western animation list.
